item.tib: dran pa yang gsang yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag bzhes shes ldan blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: ces dran pa yang gsang yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag bzhes shes ldan blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig zhes bya ba 'di/ sems dpa' mu spungs gsal tang gi snang brnyan/ skyang sprul tshe dbang g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bka' yis bskyal phyir/ gsang yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud don la nye bar brtson pa'i/ snyigs dus kyi bka' thub me ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'bod pa des/ 'dus gnas rin chen 'bar ba'i yang dben/ kun grags mthong grol khrod du/ lha mchog gang de sgrub pa'i thun skabs su/ lcags lug zla tshes bzang por sbyar ba yis/ khod spungs rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/
